Checking with Stripe

This usually takes a few seconds. If the email has not arrived in ten minutes, check spam, then write to support@casomer.com from the address you paid with.

Next

Open Studio, then:

For a supporter key: open your avatar menu → click "Become a supporter" → click "I already have a key".

For a license: open your avatar menu → select "License". On the command line: caso license <key>.
